The Coordinator will work closely with MoNE teams and the system vendor to support service rollout, system enhancements, testing, integration activities, issue resolution, and technical coordination to ensure stable and efficient service delivery.

The Coordinator will also contribute to strengthening MoNE’s technical and operational capacity through knowledge transfer, technical guidance, and support for the continuous improvement of digital government services.
